extension.news: - Core: add periodic server reachability check to detect network changes (disabled by default) - Fix hub refresh races and clean up dead code - Fix server dropdown clipping with long usernames - Preplay: respect collection sort order via metadata key lookup - Preplay: add year label to Related and Collection hub rows - Add actor/director details screen with biography and filmography - Home: Fix rare hub update crashes - Player: Fix embedded subtitle error - Home: prevent full hub reload after Go Home - Player: don't override explicit audio selection with external auto-match - Player: cache audio selection across video reloads when external audio exists - Player: recover AMLogic codec stall after audio switch race - Home: snap focus back during Go Home hold for late stray focus events
